description: Agent Feedback: submit one feedback request on a specific piece of work, as recorded: optionally the request itself with the work it names, its text as sent, when it went out and the time to respond by; the criteria it asks givers to judge the work against; and each party it went to, with whether that party saw or used the work and their relation to it (a user, a reviewer, the principal, a peer, a stakeholder or other). The signed report gives the request with any open-invitation wording it uses and the window to respond in days, every recipient as saw_work, never_saw_work or unstated, and the criteria, and names a request that leaves the loop unfocused: no specific work named, or work named only as everything or my work; no criteria, or an open invitation such as any feedback welcome in their place; and recipients who never saw or used the work; then a request with no time to respond by and a request with no named recipients, with the fix for each. This reads one request for feedback before any feedback arrives, not a formal evaluation: an evaluation’s design is wever_evaluation-design-check and scoring an agent against a rubric is wever_evaluation-scoring-check, and how a group of agents plans and splits shared work is wever_coordination-plan-check. Verdict feedback_request_unfocused, feedback_request_gaps, feedback_request_unverified or feedback_request_focused. POST /api/feedback-request-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.

criteria.description: The criteria the request asks givers to judge the work against, such as totals reconcile with the ledger.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

recipients.description: Each party the request went to, with whether they saw or used the work.

name.description: A party the request went to.

relation.description: A user of the work, a reviewer, the principal, a peer, a stakeholder or other.

saw_work.description: The party saw or used the work the request names.

text.description: The request as sent, read for open invitations such as any feedback welcome.

work.description: The specific piece of work the request asks about, such as draft 2 of the Q3 cost report or pull request 418.

name: wever_feedback-request-check
title: Feedback request check
